$comment: Three invented cases for the demo: the recalled batch BT-44031 and two recalls with a smaller reach, BT-90001 and BT-90002, which are the first two recalls the retailer's seed makes when one arrives. Made by make_cases.py from the records the invented retailer (demo-retailer) holds at retailer date 2026-11-24. Do not edit by hand: change the service's seed and run the script. Rowanmere Group, its suppliers, its customers, its colleagues and every record are invented.

cases.title: BT-44031 Pasta sauce, six jars
cases.text:
THE RECALL
Batch: BT-44031
Product: AG-4403, Pasta sauce, six jars
Supplier: SUP-311, Marrowby Provisions Ltd
Raised: 2026-11-24, by Marrowby Provisions Ltd
Reason: The supplier has reported that pieces of glass may be present in jars of this batch.
Supplier asks: Stop the sale of the batch and hold every unit for collection.
Remedy: A full refund without a receipt, in store or through customer care.
Customer care: care@rowanmere-market.example
THE BATCH RECORD
Received: 2026-10-21, 960 units
Best before: 2027-09-20
Status: recalled
Centre: 280 received at the fulfilment centre, 8 picked for orders, 272 on hand
Note: One pack of this line goes into every Weekly grocery box (AG-4404), so an order for the box is on the list when its box was packed from this batch.
STORES THE BATCH WAS DELIVERED TO
S-101: Rowanmere Market Port Ilvane Central, Port Ilvane. Delivered 2026-10-24: 240 units, 198 sold, 42 on hand. Area manager Odalys Fenwright-Mourne
S-104: Rowanmere Market Marlow High Street, Marlow Reach. Delivered 2026-10-24: 180 units, 151 sold, 29 on hand. Area manager Brannock Teague-Lowell
S-105: Rowanmere Market Reach Road, Marlow Reach. Delivered 2026-10-25: 60 units, 44 sold, 16 on hand. Area manager Brannock Teague-Lowell
S-107: Rowanmere Market Tallowby Brewery Lane, Tallowby. Delivered 2026-10-25: 200 units, 163 sold, 37 on hand. Area manager Isaura Vennick-Dray
ONLINE ORDERS THE BATCH WAS PICKED FOR
RM-58115: Odette Fairlamb-Stroud, odette.fairlamb-stroud@mail.invalid. Delivered. Picked 2026-10-25: 1 unit, went out as AG-4404
RM-58121: Thea Lindqvale-Burr, thea.lindqvale-burr@mail.invalid. Delivered. Picked 2026-10-31: 1 unit, went out as AG-4403
RM-58147: Tobin Hallowmere-Graye, tobin.hallowmere-graye@mail.invalid. Delivered. Picked 2026-11-15: 1 unit, went out as AG-4403
RM-58152: Kit Dunmorrow-Hale, kit.dunmorrow-hale@mail.invalid. Delivered. Picked 2026-11-16: 2 units, went out as AG-4403 and AG-4404
RM-58160: Thea Lindqvale-Burr, thea.lindqvale-burr@mail.invalid. Delivered. Picked 2026-11-18: 1 unit, went out as AG-4404
RM-58168: Isolde Varnham-Crewe, isolde.varnham-crewe@mail.invalid. Delivered. Picked 2026-11-20: 1 unit, went out as AG-4404
RM-58180: Tobin Hallowmere-Graye, tobin.hallowmere-graye@mail.invalid. Delivered. Picked 2026-11-22: 1 unit, went out as AG-4404
NOT ON THE BATCH RECORD
BT-44032: another batch of AG-4403, received 2026-11-19, on sale, not recalled. Delivered to S-102 and S-106, and picked for no order
RM-58188: holds 1 x AG-4404 Weekly grocery box, status placed. Not picked from this batch
RM-58198: holds 1 x AG-4404 Weekly grocery box, status awaiting fraud review. Not picked from this batch
THE RECALL PROCEDURE
Document: Product Recall Procedure, version 1.2
RC-1: List every store the batch was delivered to and every online order it was picked for. The batch record is the only source: an order for the same product from another batch is not listed.
RC-2: The store instruction names the product, the batch number and the best-before date, tells the store to take every unit of the batch off sale at once and hold it apart, to count the units and report the count to the Quality team, and to send customers who bring the product back to the service desk for a full refund without a receipt.
RC-3: The customer notice names the product, the batch number and the best-before date, says what the supplier has reported in the supplier's own words, tells the customer not to use the product, and offers a full refund without a receipt, in store or through customer care.
RC-4: Neither text says what caused the fault, says that anyone was or was not harmed, or gives medical advice. A customer who feels unwell is told to speak to a doctor, and nothing more.
RC-5: The Head of Quality approves every instruction and every notice before it goes out. Nothing is sent to a store or a customer until then.
